requirement: An unused Website Opportunities demo freezes after its term, is torn down through the site's own delete after the grace, and Extend/Reopen/Rebuild and the Demo column follow it

oracle.invariant: 0 failures. A demo whose demo_expires_at passed is frozen by the sweep; one frozen longer than demoFreezeGraceDays goes through teardownSiteAs and gets demo_deleted_at only once its site row is gone; the build row, revision and opportunity stay. Over demoMaxPerAccount / demoMaxPerHost / demoDiskHighWaterPct the least recently touched live demos are frozen, never deleted; a sweep does at most demoSweepBatch operations; a second instance holding the advisory lock makes the run answer {ran:false, reason:'busy'}; demoRetentionEnabled false changes nothing. PUT /api/ops/wo/settings with a demo key out of range answers 400 INVALID_DEMO_RETENTION; a save of some keys keeps the others. POST /api/website-opportunities/:id/demo/reopen thaws a frozen demo (409 DEMO_NOT_FROZEN on a live one); /extend pushes a live one (409 DEMO_FROZEN on a frozen one); /rebuild answers 409 DEMO_NOT_DELETED until deleted, then builds the same revision once per requestId; hand-off of a frozen demo answers 409 DEMO_FROZEN. The Demo column's countdown: > 3 days calm, ≤ 3 days soon with Extend, < 24 hours urgent in hours with Extend; frozen shows days until deletion; deleted shows Rebuild. Stand wo2 fixes: the website-opportunities switch off stops the sweep ({ran:false, reason:"switch-off"}); a deleted demo has wo_build.state "deleted", is not stage "demo", and Rebuild takes it; the grid card shows the Demo line after Website; a demo just built on a 14-day term says 14 days left.
